exposure: Clinical chorioamnionitis vs. no clinical chorioamnionitis
Pre-implementation vs. post-implementation of azithromycin policy
Women in labor and/or with rupture of membranes for ≥4 hours
Azithromycin added to standard preoperative antibiotic prophylaxis
Labor and/or rupture of membranes for ≥4 hours vs. not in labor
outcome: Postoperative infections (endometritis, wound infection, other maternal infections)
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean delivery at a single institution (n=2339)
finding: The addition of azithromycin to standard preoperative antibiotic prophylaxis for cesarean delivery did not significantly reduce the rate of postoperative infections.
